text: Artificial intelligence is changing our world, but it also brings serious ethical questions. One major concern is bias: if the data used to train AI contains unfair patterns, the AI will repeat them, leading to unequal treatment in areas like hiring or lending. Fairness means ensuring these systems do not favor one group over another. Privacy is also vital, since AI often processes personal information, so we need clear rules to protect it. Transparency requires that people understand how and why an AI makes decisions, avoiding a "black box" effect. Ultimately, responsible AI development means building these tools with careful thought, constant testing, and a commitment to human well-being over speed or profit.
